Message:
dev: move skb_scrub_packet() after eth_type_trans()

skb_scrub_packet() was called before eth_type_trans() to let eth_type_trans()
set pkt_type.

In fact, we should force pkt_type to PACKET_HOST, so move the call after
eth_type_trans().
